Hi! Long-time user but first time contributing to the actual Lean repo. I would like to add three fields that perform document formatting to Lean.Data.Lsp.Capabilities.ServerCapabilities. (lean4#13957)

The Lean LSP itself doesn't need these fields because it can't do formatting yet, but for those of us implementing their own programming language (and the accompanying language server) in Lean, it would be very convenient to have this feature.

This feels like a very small addition to add (I wouldn't even call this a feature), but when reading through the PR guidelines, I need to submit a RFC for this? Feels a little... overkill? I'm not opposed to having one but this feels like such a minor change and the response would be either "yes add it according to the LSP spec" or "no Lean.Data.Lsp is not intended for downstream users" :pleading:
The answer would be the latter: Lean.Data.Lsp is internal API for the Lean language server :-)
Sad but understandable. Thanks for letting me know!
